verdict.rationale: OpenRouter lets users restrict routing to providers with certain data policies (e.g. no-training, zero-retention) both per-request and account-wide, and offers EU/US in-region processing for enterprise, which are real retention/data-policy controls. However there is no documented mechanism for deleting already-retained data or setting explicit retention periods, and community comments (e.g. 'No ZDR. No dice') indicate the zero-data-retention toggle has real-world limitations/gaps rather than full guaranteed retention control. Missing for 10: explicit data deletion/erasure endpoint, documented retention-period settings, and independent confirmation that ZDR/data-policy filters reliably cover all providers.
